summary: The logbook can now import a flight history from Volanta or ELEVATEX, matching columns by meaning and leaving everything the export does not state empty.
releaseNotes: Settings → Data gains Import Volanta / ELEVATEX, which reads a Volanta CSV or JSON export, or the flights.csv from an ELEVATEX export, and merges the flights into the local logbook.
Re-importing the same export updates the records it already wrote instead of duplicating them, because every imported flight gets a stable id from its route and departure time.
Columns are matched by meaning, so the two exports' different headers, day-first dates and clock, minute or hours-and-minutes durations are all read correctly.
The import sits beside the existing backup controls and reports how many flights were added and how many are in the logbook afterwards.
Only what the export states is imported: landing rate, altitude and track stay empty and the logbook shows them as not measured.
